newsitem.title: UK: Four Brent dates kept before deadline - trade.
newsitem.headline: Four Brent dates kept before deadline - trade.

text.p: Four Brent cargoes due to turn wet on Friday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
A July 26-28 loader was kept by Stasco. One of two July 27-29 loaders was kept by Arcadia and the other was kept by J Aron. A July 28-30 loader was kept by Aracadia.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
